post.description:
Creates a new patient.  
**Field groups (exactly one required per group):** - referralId or referralName - primaryClinicId or primaryClinicName - statusId or statusName

error.message: Exactly one of [statusId, statusName] must be provided for status.

referralId.description: Provide exactly one of referralId or referralName

referralName.description: Provide exactly one of referralId or referralName

primaryClinicId.description: Provide exactly one of primaryClinicId or primaryClinicName

primaryClinicName.description: Provide exactly one of primaryClinicId or primaryClinicName

statusId.description: Provide exactly one of statusId or statusName

statusName.description: Provide exactly one of statusId or statusName

secondaryStatusId.description: Optional sub-status key within the chosen status's sub-workflow.

secondaryStatusName.description: Optional sub-status name within the chosen status's sub-workflow.

dob.description: Optional date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

AppointmentCreateRequest.description: Times are interpreted in the organisation's configured timezone.

assigneeId.description: ID of the user the appointment is assigned to.

end.description: End time in 24-hour HH:mm format. Must be after `start`.

sendConfirmation.description: Whether to send a confirmation email/SMS to the patient, subject to the appointment type's confirmation settings.

WebhookEnvelope.description: Standard envelope wrapping every webhook delivery.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was created.

data.description: The entity payload. Shape varies by event type.

SlimPatientRef.description: Slim patient reference included on related entities.

referral.description: UID of the lead type / referral source.

primaryClinic.description: UID of the patient's primary clinic.

referral.description: UID of the lead type / referral source.

items.description: Line item (shape varies by item type).

linkedAppointment.description: The appointment this invoice is linked to, if any.

CreditNoteData.description: A credit note record. The related order is referenced by `orderUid`.

audiogram.description: Contains `left`, `right`, and `bil` objects, each with measurement types (ac, bc, ucl, etc.) mapped to frequency-dB pairs.

leftEarHealth.description: Ear health observations (pinna, meatus, tm, discharge, earache, tinnitus, conductive).

rightEarHealth.description: Ear health observations (pinna, meatus, tm, discharge, earache, tinnitus, conductive).

hearingLossCauses.description: Flags for hearing loss causes (noise, unilateral, asymmetrical, suddenOnset, etc.).

WebhookTestData.description: Payload sent by the test webhook button.

message.example: This is a test webhook event from HearLink.

triggeredBy.description: Full name of the user who triggered the test.
